title: regression-test-runner output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the regression-test-runner role. See agents/regression-test-runner.md Step 4 for the prose contract this mirrors. This result is informational: it never gates the current sprint's PASS/FAIL verdict -- failures carry over to a future sprint as parent-less [regression][carry-over] beads.

passed.description: True only if BOTH suitePassed and smokePassed are true AND no carry-over bug was filed this run.

suitePassed.description: Result of playbook Part 1 -- the real-bd functional suite.

smokePassed.description: Result of playbook Part 2 -- the toy-sprint smoke test.

bugsFiled.description: Ids of the standalone, parent-less [regression][carry-over] beads created this run (empty array if none).

summary.description: One paragraph describing what was tested, what passed, what failed, and reiterating that the result is informational.

smokeEvidence.description: Optional structured evidence from Part 2 (the toy-sprint smoke test), so the result is machine-checkable instead of self-reported prose.

versionStdout.description: Verbatim stdout of running the toy CLI's --version on the sprint branch.

canaryStatus.description: The status field from `bd show gh-toy-4ef` (e.g. "closed").

toyRepoHeadSha.description: The toy repo's head commit SHA after the toy sprint.

blockedReason.description: Optional. Set only when the regression-test phase could not proceed because of a permission denial. Value is always missing_permissions.
